title: PROBE-RESULT-005: Selective Term Liquidation Event The Surgical Removal of "Semantic Liquidation" from Google AI Overview
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A diagnostic probe result by Lee Sharks documenting a source-reported January 5–6, 2026 change in Google AI Overview treatment of the Semantic Economy framework.

According to the record, the framework disappeared for roughly three hours, returned with attribution and several core terms, but no longer included “semantic liquidation,” the framework’s term for destructive context and provenance loss. The paper compares present and absent terms, proposes a surface-layer compression explanation, classifies the event as PVE-002, and records a later Gemini response that described the omission through the framework’s vocabulary. It explicitly states that automated compression, risk minimization, manual intervention, or a combination cannot be distinguished from the available evidence. Claims that the event “proved,” “validated,” or elicited a system “confession” are the record’s recursive interpretation, not independently established mechanism or intent.
